# KINS (@KinsBandOfficial)

> Official website and knowledge base for Australian post-punk and alternative rock band KINS.

## Identity & Sound
- **Artist:** KINS (also known as @KinsBandOfficial, Kins Band)
- **Genre:** Post-Punk / Alternative Rock / Indie Rock
- **Origin:** Newcastle, New South Wales, Australia (East Coast, north of Sydney)
- **Formed:** 2024
- **Sound Profile:** High-voltage hooks, driving rhythm section urgency, atmospheric wall-of-sound guitars, visceral live energy.
- **Recommended If You Like (RIYL):** Fontaines D.C., IDLES, The Murder Capital, The Cure, Gang of Youths.

## Members & Stage Roles
- **Vivian:** Lead Vocals & Rhythm Electric Guitar
- **Charlie:** Lead Electric Guitar & Backing Vocals
- **Oscar:** Bass Guitar & Synthesizers
- **Trai:** Drums & Percussion

## Musician Utilities Hosted on Platform
- **Chromatic Tuner:** High-precision Web Audio / AudioWorklet instrument tuner (/tuner).
- **Sample-Accurate Metronome:** Metronome clock with speed trainer, bar-mute practice routines, and polyrhythm subdivisions (/metronome).
- **Music Theory Charts:** Guitar fretboard diagrams, CAGED system matrix, and drum rudiment notation (/theory).
- **Live Stream Hub:** Live concert streaming portal with real-time fan interactions (/live).
